lessons: Review found the design sound: one shared compose helper in clutch/meta.py used by both refresh and fill, the .py trim applied to model-supplied relates, and blank model owners rejected. Redo all of that from the merge base. Only two small defects remain.

README.md line ~20: keep the list punctuation. Write it as: 'Use `clutch meta refresh` to update configured file metadata, `clutch meta check` to report missing, empty or drifted blocks, and `clutch meta fill` to fill them using a read-only model.'

tests/unit/test_meta_fill.py review_reply test: don't use one-letter paths like "a", since "a" is a substring of the label "extra". Use paths such as "docs/asked.md" and "docs/added.md", and assert the exact set of finding messages so that a missing or swapped path fails the test (criterion 4).

Before committing, reread every doc sentence you edited (README.md, docs/how-clutch-works.md section 2, clutch/docs/host-running.md). Make sure the existing meta refresh and meta check wording is still intact and correctly punctuated.
